hero_body: Mentorship packaged into a few clear formats — so you know what you're signing up for before the first conversation.

offerings.title: Operations & Automation Audit
offerings.body: A focused, time-boxed review of how your operations and systems currently run — where manual work is costing you time, and where automation would actually pay off. Ends with a clear, prioritized set of recommendations.

offerings.title: Ongoing 1:1 Mentorship
offerings.body: Regular working sessions over an extended period — for founders and leaders who want a consistent sounding board as they make strategy, systems, and hiring decisions in real time.
offerings.best_for: Best for: founders in an active build or growth phase.

offerings.title: Automation Implementation Mentorship
offerings.body: Hands-on guidance while your team actually builds and rolls out an automation, ERP, or digital transformation initiative — not just advice from the sidelines, but a mentor staying close through execution.
